text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 7

The panel was all women, and so are you and the person hired. An all-female panel selecting a woman over another woman gives you no basis for a sex-discrimination claim — there's no differential treatment by sex to point to. Raising it would likely read as grasping and would undercut the part of your case that is genuinely strong.

That stronger case: on paper you have the deeper qualification (PhD vs. master's) and eight years running a section, while "broad leadership experience" is vague. And they've ignored a reasonable request for two weeks.

Send a firm follow-up, in writing, citing the date of your first request and any applicable deadline. Judge the decision once you see their reasoning.
